svg.text: A press column over the one turning, heated pot position (P0), a 5-axis handler; all ware goes to the dishwasher.
1460 × 600 × 2150 mm (bay A column 440, B hob 600, C oven/port 420)
7 motion actuators · press 4 kN, 600 mm stroke · P0 0–500 rpm
coverage ≈ 93 % (231 of 248 meals) · ≈ 60 handling events per meal
parts ≈ 9 k€ prototype, ≈ 4.7 k€ design-to-cost (+ oven)
dry rail box at the rear: handler X belt 1 400 mm, sealing band
TOP VIEW at deck level (rear wall at top)
1 Opened box of peeled onions enters through the port onto bench B
2 Handler grips the box, tips onions into the tube; jaw load pins weigh the dose
3 Pusher on top, crosshead pulls down: 6 mm dice fall into hot fat on P0
4 Mince tipped in; kneading roller hangs still, P0 turns the pot
5 8 Frikadellen into the pan on H1, fried, turned as a pan pair
6 Boiled potatoes into the tube on the 4.5 mm plate: riced into hot milk
7 Plate on P0: mash and Frikadellen placed while P0 turns; plate out through the port
8 Piston pigs the tube empty; tube cold-rinsed at the seat and sent to the dishwasher

g.text: 1/8 Port: an opened box of peeled onions slides in onto bench B; the handler comes over from its park position
2/8 Dose by tipping: the jaw grips the box flange, rolls it over the tube mouth; load pins in the jaw stop at the target weight
3/8 Dice: bought 6 mm push-dicer + pusher; the crosshead pulls down (4 kN max), dice drop straight into the hot pot on P0
4/8 Knead: tube lifted out, kneading roller hangs from the crosshead and stands still while P0 turns the pot under it
5/8 Fry: portions set into the pan on H1; turned by putting a second pan on top and rolling the pair 180°
6/8 Mash: boiled potatoes tipped into the tube on the 4.5 mm plate; the press rices them into hot milk, skins stay on the plate
7/8 Plate: the plate stands on P0 and turns while mash and Frikadellen are placed; then it leaves through the port
8/8 Clean: the piston pushes the tube empty, the tube is cold-rinsed at the seat within 2 min and leaves for the dishwasher
